'''Hayar''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who resided in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="IC 501st" />

Shortly after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when an Imperial garrison was established on Mandalore, Hayar and his companion [[Jarkyc]] managed to convince the Imperial garrison [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Mandalore)|commander]] that a [[City of Bone|failed theme park]], built by Hayar's [[Hayar's brother|brother]], was a sacred Mandalorian temple. Intending to inspire awe among the local populace, the theme park was bought by the Empire which was used as their garrison base.<ref name="IC 501st" />
